rca_of_the_issue: When loyalty points or coupon code fully covered the bill (roundedTotal=0), the app was still redirecting to Razorpay payment gateway which asked for Rs1 minimum payment. The fix adds roundedTotal <= 0 guards at 4 payment decision points to force paymentType to 'postpaid', skip Razorpay modal, hide payment selector, and show 'Place Order' button label instead of 'Pay & Proceed Rs0.00'.
